pages.title: Introdução
pages.text: There are a number of ways to produce light in $(tfg_short). However, nearly all light sources do not last forever!$(br)Unlike vanilla Minecraft, you will need to keep an eye on your lights to re-ignite them when they burn out. The higher quality the light source is, the longer it will last.$(br)Permanent lightsources aren't available until much later, unless you get creative.

pages.title: Torches
pages.text: Torches can be made by heating sticks or stick bunches in a $(l:craftsmanship/firepit)Firepit$() or other heating device.$(br)Torches last for 3 days, and then become $(thing)Dead Torches$(), which may be relit by clicking them with a torch, or by using a fire starting tool on them. Sticks can also be clicked on torches to light them. Torches dropped in water turn into $(thing)Wood Ash$() or $(thing)Sticks$().
Torches may be tossed on log piles or $(l:craftsmanship/pit_kiln)Pit Kilns$() to ignite them.

pages.title: Candles
pages.text: Candles are made from $(thing)Wax$() or $(thing)Tallow$() and last for 30 days before needing to be relit.$(br)Candles may be placed and lit on the ground or in $(l:cooking/jam#jarbnet)Jarbnets$(). The amount of candles placed effects the light-level they emit.
Candles can be $(thing)dyed$() into all 16 colors!.

pages.title: Jack 'o Lanterns
pages.text: Jack 'o Lanterns are the lit version of $(thing)Carved Pumpkins$(), and last for 4.5 days, before reverting to carved pumpkins.$(br)Pumpkins are carved by holding them in hand and $(l:craftsmanship/sticks_and_stones)Knapping$().
There are many fun designs of Jack 'o Lanterns to choose from!

pages.title: Lamps
pages.text: Lamps are a long term source of light that burn liquid fuels. Lamps retain their fuel content when broken. You can fuel lamps automatically with $(thing)Pipes$() or manually with $(l:cooking/drinking_containers)Fluid Containers$().$(br)You can check capable lamp fuels in $(emi) by viewing a lamp. $(thing)Lava$() will burn forever but must be in a $(item)Blue Steel Lamp$(). $(thing)Liquid Glowstone$() is the same, but works in any lamp.
Lamps can hang from blocks. $(thing)Chains$() and $(thing)Pipes$() are particularly nice choices.

pages.title: Permanent Light
pages.text: By the time you make an $(item)Extractor$() and $(item)Fluid Solidifier$() you can begin producing a variety of decorative permanent light sources with $(thing)Liquid Glowstone$() and $(thing)Glowstone Blocks$().$(br)Besides advancing in tech, there are some creative ways to light up an area, such as $(l:agriculture/aqueducts)Lava Aqueducts$().
